links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses on chemical eye injuries (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease 33.84 (SD 2.97); Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 14.21 (SD 0.97), college-level; passive voice 7.22% of sentences. No significant differences across 3 categories.
links.quote: The average Flesch Reading Ease Score was 33.84 (SD 2.97), indicating a fairly challenging reading level, while the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level averaged 14.21 (SD 0.97), suitable for readers with college-level proficiency.

links.outcome: Whether responses emphasized urgency of care and guideline-specific elements for chemical eye injuries
links.effect: Responses were mostly accurate and coherent but sometimes overlooked critical clinical details such as emphasizing the urgency of care, precise classification, and detailed diagnostic or management protocols.
